notes.title: Terrible Lizards Selected for PAX Rising!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44963870/9cb2fedc76e20938c48a4e2286c6d4b6dfa60ba3.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re excited to share that [b]Terrible Lizards[/b] has been officially selected for the [b]PAX Rising Showcase[/b] at [b]PAX West 2025[/b]![/p][p]This will be the [b]first public hands-on demo[/b] for [i]Terrible Lizards[/i], and we can’t wait for players to step into the world we’ve been building.[/p][p][b]Where:[/b] PAX Rising Showcase, PAX West – Seattle, WA
[b]When:[/b] Aug 29-Sept 1[/p][p] [b]What:[/b] Play a slice of the game featuring:[/p][list][*][p]Heart-pounding chase sequence[/p][/*][*][p]First-person platforming & traversal[/p][/*][*][p]A glimpse at our terrifying prehistoric predators[/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you’re a fan of indie horror, intense movement-based gameplay, or just want to survive against something with far too many teeth, we’d love to see you there.[/p][p]📍 [b]Find us in the PAX Rising area at booth #825[/b] and let us know what you think![/p]
